summary: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists a standing tower in Montgomery County with no NHLR number; no history, build date or access found.

evidence.supports: tower listed as standing in Montgomery County, with coordinates; row shows only name, county, coordinates and status
expands NHLR as the National Historic Lookout Register (the name shown on the nhlr.org Virginia index)

notes_for_editor: Only readable source is the FFLA Virginia index row, shared with the other two towers. One search (no readable history) pointed to another FFLA Virginia page last updated 11/20/2011, which was neither read nor cited. The row carries no NHLR or FFLOS number and no build, builder, height or staffing details. Treat as a thin listing; a human should check Montgomery County or Virginia Department of Forestry records before any edit. Page reads: none new. Searches: 1. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the NHLR expansion had no cited source, so the nhlr.org Virginia index was added as source 2 and footnote 2 was added to the story. The 'access and rental arrangement not recorded' sentence is an absence claim that the row supports; it was kept.
